en.title: The subjunctive
en.summary: The subjunctive expresses a wish, a demand or an unreal situation; in English it is rare and formal.

paragraphs: The subjunctive expresses a wish, a demand or an unreal situation. In English it is rare and mostly formal.

items: It is important that she **arrive** on time.
If I **were** you, I would go.

paragraphs: The present subjunctive uses the base form of the verb, even for he, she and it. The past subjunctive of be is were for every person. In everyday speech people often use should or the ordinary form instead.

blocks.html:
UseExample
demandThey insist that he leave.
suggestionI suggest that she see a doctor.
unreal conditionIf I were rich, I would travel.
